title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording with crystal‑clear vocals and Jerry’s guitar, showcasing a smoking Cassidy and a standout Little Red Rooster.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers surprisingly pristine sound for an audience source—vocals are clear, the mix is balanced and Jerry’s lead work shines.  The concert itself is described as solid from start to finish with high energy, highlighted by a killer performance of “Cassidy” and an unforgettable slide‑guitar moment on “Little Red Rooster.”

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are strongly positive (4–5 stars) and consistently praise both the show’s energy and the high‑quality audience recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear vocals, crisp guitar tone, well‑balanced mix for an audience tape; no complaints of mud or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid and engaging from start to finish, maintaining high momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar sounds great and his vocals are praised; noted for a memorable slide‑guitar moment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland receives special praise, indicating strong keyboard contribution.
